remarks: Live your best life in the pulse of Downtown Stamford in this newly renovated, spacious one bedroom/1-bath apartment in a secure mid-rise building. A sunny, open living/dining area with new flooring complements the modern new kitchen with quartz countertops. Great closet space will keep you organized and a reserved parking spot, as well as heat, Hot Water and cooking gas are ALL INCLUDED in the rent! Enjoy living in the heart of the city, steps from the renowned Avon Theater, popular downtown restaurants, UCONN, shops, bars, the Ferguson library, and public transportation. Come see the possibilities and apply today!
